lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You found us. Don't tell anyone how.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: This frequency does not exist. And yet here you are, listening to it. Splendid.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Unlicensed! Unregistered! Unbelievably on air! Stay tuned!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Shh. You found us. Keep it down. They've got ears everywhere.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Breaker, breaker. You've got the station that isn't. Come on back.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You are not listening to this. Officially.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Unofficially, welcome.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Broadcasting from a secret location. It's a shed. Don't tell anyone it's a shed.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Um. This is pirate radio. Hi. You're listening to pirate radio. That's, yeah. That's it.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: No name. No licence. No fixed abode. We do, however, have a kettle.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hello to everybody who tuned in by accident! That's everybody! Welcome!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You've drifted off the edge of the dial. Don't panic. It's nicer out here. Fewer rules.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: This station has been shut down eleven times. This is the twelfth time it's open.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Nobody sent you. Nobody's listening. Except you, and us, and possibly a van.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: If you can hear this, you're one of us now. Sorry. There isn't a form.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Please do not adjust your set. Your set is fine. It is we who are wrong.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Off the map, off the books, on the air. Keep it between the lines, drivers.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: This is the station your mum warned you about! Hi, your mum!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Right. That was a record. I don't know who made it. I don't think they know either.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Somebody left it on the step of the shed with a note that said, play this. So I did. That's how it works out here. Nobody sends anything in properly.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Thirty one years I've been doing this. Never had a licence. Never had a sponsor. Never had a listener I could prove.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: And yet here you are. Hello, proof.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Funny thing. You put a voice out into the dark with no name on it, and now and then the dark writes back. One letter a year, maybe.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Last year's said, keep going. So.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Good evening, or morning, or whatever it is out there! It's always about four in the afternoon up here, because of the skylight!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: My nan says hello! She says keep it down! Hello, nan!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Big shout out to everyone listening! Both of you!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: I can see the signal meter going. That's you! You're the little needle! Love the little needle!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Ooh, just had a message from a listener. It says, please stop.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Love that! Love the engagement! Here's another one!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Sorry, I have to keep it down tonight. There's a detector van parked across the street.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: It's doing a three point turn. Now it's doing a seven point turn. Bless it. Here's a quiet one.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We're broadcasting in a whisper tonight, so they can't find us. That's how it works. I think. I read it on the back of a cereal box.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: The next song is also very quiet. Lean in.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Good evening. Pirate radio. One never imagined. Father wanted one to go into law.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Instead, one is broadcasting from a rowing boat, at night, without permission. Father would be furious.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Father may be listening. Hello, Father.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Next, a tune of uncertain provenance. Found in a drawer. One suspects it was stolen.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: One is a pirate, after all. One is trying to get into the spirit of the thing.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hi. Um. Is this on? The red light's on. That means it's on.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hi. This is my first night. I'm a pirate. Sorry. I'm supposed to say that with more swagger.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: I'm a pirate. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Okay, I've been told to say something cool between songs. I wrote it down. It says, stay rebellious.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Okay. Stay rebellious. And drink some water. That bit's not on the card. That's from me.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: When I started, there were no rules. Then they made rules, and I broke them.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Then they made rules about breaking rules. I broke those too. Now I'm mostly just tired. Here's a song.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: People ask why I keep going. Fifty years on a frequency nobody's supposed to find.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Somebody has to play the songs nobody asked for. Otherwise, who would? This is one of those.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: This is your overnight driver, coming at you from a lay by between two realities.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Road's quiet. Kettle's plugged into the lighter socket. Life is good. Here's one for the long stretch.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Okay, I have to be quick, because my mum thinks I'm doing homework. This is technically homework.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: It's a project about radio waves. I'm the radio waves. Next track!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Mum's just asked if I'm talking to someone. I said no. Technically, I'm talking to everyone.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hi, everyone. Please don't tell my mum.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: A reminder that this station is entirely unofficial. We are not affiliated with any authority, network, empire or society.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We did once write to the society. They wrote back, asking us to stop writing.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: If you've just joined us, there's nothing to join. We're not a club. There's no badge.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: I mean, I made a badge. It says pirate. There's only the one. I'm wearing it.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Fun fact! This whole station runs off a bicycle! My cousin is pedalling it right now! Say hello, Derek!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Derek can't talk, he's pedalling! Here's a fast one, to help Derek!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Weather on the sideways road tonight is fog, with a chance of Tuesday. Drive slow. Wave at the ghosts. They like a wave.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: That record was older than I am. I found it in a skip behind the Broadcast Authority.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: They throw out all the good ones. Every Thursday. I'm always there.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Someone just asked what genre this station is. Good question. I think the genre is, we had these records.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: So. More of those.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: If you're listening on headphones, hello. You're the only one I can be properly quiet for.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Everyone else, turn it up a bit. We're right here.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Shout out to the lads at Radio Free Shed. Keep the faith, boys.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: And fix your aerial. You're coming in sideways.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Big love to everyone at the Midnight Wrong Number! Keep ringing! Somebody's bound to pick up eventually!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: And to the man who keeps ringing us for a taxi. We're not a taxi! But we play you a song every time, and that's sort of a lift!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Respect to Teodor, at Relay Four. Not a pirate. Just out there, asking if anyone can hear him.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We hear you, Teodor. We can't say so properly. We're not allowed to exist.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We've had a request. It arrived on a paper aeroplane, through the window of the boat.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: It says, play something sad that you can dance to.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: One could not agree more.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: A dedication. This goes out to the night shift. The cleaners, the bakers, the drivers hauling weather, and anyone on a ship out there, keeping the lights on.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We see you. Well. We don't. But we know you're there.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: This one's a request from a listener who'd rather not be named, for a listener who'd rather not be named.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: From someone who isn't allowed to be named. Pirate radio, everyone. Isn't it romantic.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Greetings to all the other pirates on the deep band. The Kitchen Table Broadcasting Company. The Unlicensed Hour. That bloke who only plays bells.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Keep it up. Somebody's listening. It's usually me.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Shout out to the convoy on the river road, and to whoever's hauling that lorry full of fog.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Can't see you, friend. But we can hear your indicator.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We've had a request for something with a good drum bit, from someone called Grandad.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hi, Grandad. How did you find this? Never mind. Good drum bit, coming up.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Hot Batteries! Batteries that fell off the back of a dimension! Still warm! Still ninety percent full of somebody else's energy!

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Use them in your torch. Use them in your radio. Use them in your clock, and get a few extra hours from somebody else's week.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Hot Batteries. Don't ask where they came from. We genuinely don't know.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Big Terry's Bargain Aerials. Picks up every station. Including the ones you don't want.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Picks up your neighbour's phone calls. Picks up radio plays from the year before last. On a clear night, picks up a man in a lighthouse, reading the weather to nobody.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Big Terry's. Your neighbours will hate it.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Always wanted a frequency of your own? We've got loads. All lightly used. Previous owners, mostly gone.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: One of them still plays faint jazz in the evenings. We consider that a feature. Make us an offer.

lines.speaker: Small Print
lines.text: Frequencies sold as seen. Faint jazz cannot be removed. Please do not ask the jazz to leave. It lives there.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Worried about the authorities? Get a licence! An Unofficial Licence looks almost exactly like a real one. It's got a stamp!

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: The stamp is a potato. Nobody looks that closely.

lines.speaker: Small Print
lines.text: Unofficial Licences are not licences. They are paper. Very nice paper. Potato not included.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Van-Away! The spray that keeps detector vans at bay!

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Just spray it round your shed, and detector vans will drive straight past, with a vague feeling of loss and a sudden urge to ring their mothers.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Van-Away. Smells of lavender. And defiance.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: The Midnight Pantry. The shop that's only open when it's shut. Knock twice. Ask for Lorna.

lines.speaker: Lorna
lines.text: Hello, love. What do you need? Don't tell me. I've got it. It's in a bag.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Whatever you need, Lorna has it, in a bag. Don't open the bag until you get home. Lorna is very clear about the bag.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Aerial Tom! He'll fit your aerial! He'll fix your aerial! And if necessary, he'll talk to your aerial. Some aerials just need to be heard.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Aerial Tom. He's been up on a roof since before you were born. Please, somebody, take him a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Psst. Round the back of Grumbel's Ladders, there's a bloke. He sells the ladders that didn't pass inspection.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Too tall. Too short. One of them goes slightly sideways in time.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Grumbel's Seconds. Up is a choice. Down is a bargain.

lines.speaker: Small Print
lines.text: Not affiliated with Grumbel's Ladders. Mister Grumbel has asked us to stop. Up is a choice. So is stopping. We have chosen not to.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Mystery Records, by the kilo! No labels! No sleeves! No questions!

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Some of them are music. Some of them are somebody's wedding speech. One of them is a man saying hello down a well, for forty minutes.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Mystery Records. Fifty pence a kilo. You'll never know what you've got. Neither will we.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Reconditioned Silence. Second hand quiet, from libraries, mountaintops, and the ends of long arguments.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Lightly scuffed. Ideal for flats, offices, and the back seat on long journeys.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Reconditioned Silence. You'll hardly hear it.

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Is your shed secretly a radio station? Is your radio station secretly a shed?

lines.speaker: Advert
lines.text: Then you need Shed Shield. The only insurance for sheds that are quietly something else. Covers fire, flood, and men in grey coats.

lines.speaker: Small Print
lines.text: Shed Shield does not cover sheds that are bigger on the inside. Those are a different policy, and a different conversation.

clips.title: The Man in the Grey Coat

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Public service announcement. If a man in a grey coat knocks and asks whether you've been listening to unlicensed broadcasts, the correct answer is, what's a broadcast.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Then offer him a biscuit. They never get offered biscuits. It throws them right off.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Detector van update! A van's been spotted on the corner of Third and Elsewhere! Another's been spotted on the corner of Elsewhere and Third!

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We think it's the same van. It's lost. Can somebody give it directions? It looks sad.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: The Multiverse Broadcast Authority would like you to know that this station is illegal.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We would like you to know that the Multiverse Broadcast Authority listens to us on its lunch break. We can tell. They ring in requests.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Warning. The authorities have a new device that can tell whether you're listening to pirate radio. It works by asking you.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Don't answer it. It's very polite, and very persuasive. Just hum until it goes away.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Safety tip. Never tell anyone where we are.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You don't know where we are. We don't know where we are. That's the safety.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: If we suddenly go off the air, don't worry. We'll be back. Probably on a different frequency. Possibly as different people.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Listen out for the same bad jokes. That's how you'll know it's us.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: A word to the drivers. If you see flashing lights on the sideways road, it's the Broadcast Authority.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Wave. Smile. Tell them you're listening to the weather. You are, in a way.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hello? Am I on?

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You're on. Who's this?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: I've been trying to find you for weeks. I tuned past you on a Tuesday, and I've been going up and down the dial ever since.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Well. You found us. What do you want to hear?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Oh, I don't mind. I just wanted to know you were real.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Real-ish. Same as everyone. This one's for you.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: You're on the air! Who's this?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. Is this the request line?

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Bev! We've heard all about you! It's not the request line. But for you, Bev, it can be. Go on.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: It goes, da da dum, da da.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We'll have a look, Bev. We'll have a proper look.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: That's what they all say, love. Thank you anyway.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hello, you're on. Um. Live. Sort of.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Good evening. I'd like to make a request. And also, a formal complaint.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Which one first?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: The request. The complaint can wait. It's been waiting eleven years. Have you got anything with a saxophone in it?

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: We've got one saxophone record.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: That'll do. Lovely. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: And the complaint is, you are operating an unlicensed station.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: That's fair.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Right. Well. Same time tomorrow, then.

lines.speaker: Multiverse Broadcast Authority
lines.text: This is the Multiverse Broadcast Authority. This station is operating without a—

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Sorry about that. Wrong cable. Where were we.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: Hang on, hang on. Someone's knocking on the cab.

lines.speaker: Pirate DJ
lines.text: It's all right. It's an owl.
